paired_fresh.uncertainty: Paired 20000-bootstrap, seed42; descriptive for this category-balanced sample, not service-population uncertainty or proof of equivalence

fresh.scope: household/hobby service draft, not verified Sazo policy
fresh.strategy: Original full HS2022 greedy 2/4/6, single path, no child-description enrichment or reranking
fresh.denominator: All 93 selected cases; abstentions/errors count wrong
fresh.input: Identical title/attributes/category only; reference labels joined after all inference
fresh.timing: Sequential HTTP+parse+validation sum per item; providers concurrent and randomized within item
fresh.prior_observation: Fresh IDs never evaluated in original94 or improved94; authors may inspect input facts for scope, not outcomes

policy.status: Service-scope research draft, not verified Sazo policy or import permission
policy.manual_review: Inspect sampled titles and attributes before any new inference. Overrides require a recorded product-fact-based reason, never labels/predictions. Do not silently replace rejected sampled products.
policy.hard_cases: Keep in-scope mixed materials, sets, parts, inconsistent/missing attributes, ambiguous product facts and damaged/used descriptions; no difficulty filtering.
policy.sampling: Exclude previous 94 pilot IDs from fresh validation pool, then fixed SHA256(scope-v1|ID) order, balanced round-robin across eligible top categories, 96 maximum; sampling before reading new predictions or reference labels.
policy.limitations: Personal use inferred from product type, not verified purchaser intent. Text-only input. Category-balanced sample not marketplace-frequency representative. Country/HS edition differences persist. Original benchmark labels are US expert references, not Korean customs rulings.
